entries.proposition: Cells were hESC (H9) differentiated to neural precursor cells; VPA was used at 600 uM and TSA at 10 nM unless stated.
entries.snippet: treatment with valproic acid (VPA) was done with a concentration of 600 µM

entries.proposition: VPA exposure for 6 h, 4 d or 6 d produced probe-set lists of increasing size (2,760 for VPA at 4 d); early responses reversed after washout.
entries.snippet: Treatment for 4 days (T4d) resulted in similar numbers of up-/down-regulated PS (total: 1,342 PS for TSA, 2,760 PS for VPA).
entries.anchor: Results, Transcriptome changes triggered by exposure to HDACi for various time periods, para 2

entries.proposition: The paper's own conclusion: after prolonged exposure the transcriptome mainly reflects an altered developmental stage, not the drug mode of action (and early responses are reversible).
entries.snippet: All these early regulations were reversed after a 6-day washout period (EP).
entries.anchor: Results, Transcriptome changes triggered by exposure to HDACi for various time periods, para 2

entries.proposition: Treated-versus-control lists use BH-adjusted p below 0.05 with fold change above 1.5 or below 2/3, relative to untreated controls lysed the same day.
entries.snippet: T4d to C4d and T6d, early pulse (EP), medium pulse (MP), and late pulse (LP) to C6d

entries.proposition: The developmental (untreated) baseline lists use a stricter threshold than the treatment lists.
entries.anchor: Results, Transcriptome changes triggered by exposure to HDACi for various time periods, para 1

entries.proposition: The VPA 4-day list (600 uM) names WWOX with fold change 1.574 (up), p 0.00249, adjusted p 0.042 (probe 219077_s_at); it is the only WWOX row in any treated list of MOESM3.
entries.anchor: Supplementary Table S2, sheet T4d VPA, row 1384

entries.proposition: The header of the same sheet fixes the condition as 600 uM VPA, 4-day exposure.
entries.snippet: SHEET=T4d VPA | ROW=1 | A=Supplementary Table S2 | B=T4d | E=600 µM VPA
entries.anchor: Supplementary Table S2, sheet T4d VPA, row 1

entries.proposition: The only other WWOX row in the file set is in the UNTREATED developmental table: fold change 0.59 at 6 h versus hESC, a developmental change not a drug effect.
That sheet compares differentiating cells with hESC and carries no drug.
entries.snippet: hESC were differentiated towards NEP and samples were taken after 6h, 4d and 6d of differentiation. Differentially expressed PS were determined compared to hESC.
